name: Nurse Coloring Book: Sweary Midnight Edition
seoTitle: Sweary Nurse Coloring Book, Midnight Edition
metaDescription: A swear word adult coloring book filled with relatable nurse problems. A funny gift for night shift nurses and friends who love salty humor.
summary: A sweary adult coloring book full of nurse problems. Best for the night shift nurse who curses like a sailor and laughs about it.
whyItWorks: Sometimes the most honest response to a shift is a word you cannot say in front of patients. A swear word coloring book gives that frustration somewhere harmless to go. Every nurse has a list of daily annoyances, from missing supplies to call lights that never stop, and seeing those problems written out with a little profanity can feel strangely validating.

The midnight edition name makes it an especially good fit for night shift nurses, who tend to have the darkest and funniest humor on the unit. It is the kind of gift that gets passed around and laughed at in the break room, then taken home for a quiet evening of coloring. Give it to a close friend or a fellow nurse who you know appreciates salty language, ideally with a set of bright gel pens. It is not one for a professional thank you or a family member who would be offended, so match it to the person's humor.
goodToKnow: Contains swear words, so keep it away from kids and formal workplace gift exchanges.
Check the listing preview to see what the midnight edition pages look like.
Gel pens or metallic markers make a fun pairing.

faq.q: Is this okay for a work Secret Santa?
faq.a: Only if you know your unit's humor well. The swearing makes it a better pick for a close friend than a formal exchange.

faq.q: Why is it a good night shift gift?
faq.a: The midnight edition theme and the blunt humor match the tone many night shift nurses already share with each other.
